name: datalang-vscode
description: DataLang language support and configuration for its Python analysis backend.

datalang.pythonExecutable.markdownDescription: Python executable name on PATH or absolute path to the interpreter for the DataLang backend. Supply an executable only, without command-line arguments. Backend execution requires a trusted workspace.

datalang.backendPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the DataLang repository root containing `src/lexer/lexer.py` and `src/parser/parser.py`. Empty means the backend is not configured. Backend execution requires a trusted workspace.

datalang.analysisDebounceMs.markdownDescription: Delay in milliseconds after the last document edit before requesting backend analysis. Set to `0` to request analysis immediately.

datalang.analysisTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Maximum time in milliseconds for each Python analysis request, including startup and CSV schema inspection. Timed-out processes are terminated.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
